Oncoming cars creep forward in left lane behind departed SUV as snow falls continuously across wet reflective asphalt.

caption: The video captures a snowy town main street at night, with brick storefronts and a lit BikeSparks sign on the left, lampposts strung with lights, and a red fire hydrant on the right sidewalk, all over wet reflective asphalt. In the left lane a dark SUV with bright headlights grows larger as it approaches, then passes out of frame at the left edge. Meanwhile a white SUV with illuminated taillights steadily recedes down the right side of the street. A dark minivan enters from the bottom-left foreground, swings toward the centre, and proceeds away from the camera with its red taillights glowing. Behind the departed SUV, a slow queue of oncoming cars creeps forward in the left lane. The background buildings, lampposts and hydrant remain fixed while light reflections shift on the slick pavement. Snow falls continuously across the scene.
